name: Stellar Wreck
storyline: Stranded aboard a wrecked spacecraft adrift in the void, you wake up alone. No crew. No answers. Just the hum of failing systems — and the will to survive.
summary:
Stellar Wreck is a game where you control a child who must survive in space aboard a partially broken spaceship.

(more content is still in development) You must complete quests and uncover your character's past, but you can also take it slow and build up your ship with beautiful decorations.

To gather decorations, you'll need to arm yourself with weapons and tools to fight strange alien monsters and... actual animals...?

There's a whole range of skills and abilities available!
